prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

The present invention relates to a wheel mount for a vehicle test bench for motor vehicles having steerable wheels, wherein the wheel mount comprises a floating plate as well as at least one roller supported on the floating plate and movable with the floating plate in a horizontal plane. According to the present invention, the wheel mount has a first working state, in which the part of the floating plate, on which the at least one roller is supported, is rotatably supported around a vertical axis, which is located ahead of the at least one wheel contact point on the at least one roller with respect to the driving direction of a vehicle located in the roller dynamometer. In addition, the wheel mount has a second working state, in which the part of the floating plate, on which the at least one roller is supported, is rotatably supported around a vertical axis, which is located behind the at least one wheel contact point with respect to the driving direction of a vehicle located in the roller dynamometer. Furthermore, actuators are assigned to the floating plate for rotating the part of the floating plate, on which the at least one roller is supported, around the corresponding axis in the first as well as in the second working state.

outputs.L1: The present invention relates to a wheel mount for a vehicle test bench for motor vehicles having steerable wheels. The wheel mount comprises a floating plate and at least one roller supported on the floating plate and movable with the floating plate in a horizontal plane. According to the invention, the wheel mount has a first operating state in which the portion of the floating plate supporting the at least one roller is rotatably mounted about a vertical axis located ahead of the at least one wheel contact point on the at least one roller, relative to the driving direction of a vehicle positioned in the roller dynamometer. The wheel mount further has a second operating state in which the portion of the floating plate supporting the at least one roller is rotatably mounted about a vertical axis located behind the at least one wheel contact point, relative to the driving direction of a vehicle positioned in the roller dynamometer. Furthermore, actuators are assigned to the floating plate to rotate the portion of the floating plate supporting the at least one roller about the corresponding axis in both the first and second operating states.
outputs.L2:
The invention concerns a wheel support for a vehicle test bench designed for motor vehicles with steerable wheels. The wheel support includes a floating plate and at least one roller mounted on the plate so that the roller can move together with it in a horizontal plane.

The wheel support can operate in two modes. In the first mode, the portion of the floating plate carrying the roller is mounted to pivot about a vertical axis positioned, relative to the vehicle’s direction of travel on the roller dynamometer, in front of the wheel’s contact point with the roller. In the second mode, that same portion of the floating plate pivots about a vertical axis located behind the wheel contact point when viewed in the vehicle’s direction of travel.

Actuators associated with the floating plate rotate the roller-supporting portion about the applicable vertical axis in each operating mode.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a wheel mount for a vehicle test bench intended for testing motor vehicles equipped with steerable wheels. The wheel mount comprises a floating plate and at least one roller supported on the floating plate. The roller is horizontally movable together with the floating plate, thereby allowing the wheel mount to accommodate movements of a vehicle wheel during testing.

The wheel mount is configured to operate in at least two working states. In the first working state, the portion of the floating plate supporting the roller is rotatable about a vertical axis positioned ahead of the wheel contact point, viewed in the vehicle’s direction of travel. In the second working state, the roller-supporting portion of the floating plate is rotatable about a different vertical axis positioned behind the wheel contact point in the vehicle’s direction of travel.

Actuators are provided to actively rotate the roller-supporting portion of the floating plate about the corresponding vertical axis in each working state. This arrangement enables the wheel mount to reproduce or accommodate different steering and wheel-movement conditions during vehicle testing.
outputs.L4:
A vehicle test-bench wheel mount is designed to receive a steerable wheel and to reproduce the forces and movements that occur during different steering conditions. The mount includes a floating plate that is movable substantially in a horizontal plane. At least one roller is supported on the floating plate and engages the tread of the wheel so that the wheel can rotate while remaining positioned on the test bench.

The floating plate can be pivoted selectively about different substantially vertical axes. At least one pivot axis is located ahead of the wheel’s contact point in the direction of travel, while another pivot axis is located behind the contact point. Depending on the selected operating state, the plate is coupled to the appropriate pivot axis, and one or more actuators rotate or displace the plate about that axis.

By selecting the forward or rearward pivot axis and controlling the corresponding actuator, the test bench can impose defined angular movements and lateral forces on the wheel. This arrangement makes it possible to simulate different steering geometries, load conditions, and vehicle responses without moving an entire vehicle. The wheel mount can therefore be used to evaluate steering behavior, wheel alignment, suspension response, tire characteristics, and related components under repeatable and controllable test conditions.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a wheel mount used in a vehicle test bench for motor vehicles with steerable wheels, including a floating plate, at least one roller, two operating states with vertical pivot axes located respectively ahead of and behind the wheel contact point, and actuators for rotating the roller-supporting portion.
counterfactuals.output: A wheel mount for a vehicle test bench for motor vehicles having steerable wheels comprises a floating plate configured to support a vehicle wheel at a wheel contact point and to permit lateral movement of the wheel. The floating plate includes at least one roller and a roller-supporting portion carrying the at least one roller. The wheel mount is selectively configurable between a first operating state, in which the roller-supporting portion is pivotable about a substantially vertical first pivot axis located ahead of the wheel contact point in a longitudinal direction of the vehicle, and a second operating state, in which the roller-supporting portion is pivotable about a substantially vertical second pivot axis located behind the wheel contact point. One or more actuators are operatively coupled to the roller-supporting portion and configured to rotate the roller-supporting portion about the respective pivot axis, thereby applying controlled steering forces or steering movements to the wheel during testing.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe the present invention in formal patent language: a roller dynamometer wheel mount whose floating plate can pivot about different vertical axes depending on the selected working state.
counterfactuals.output: The present invention relates to a wheel-mounting assembly for a roller dynamometer. The assembly comprises a support structure, a floating plate configured to support a vehicle wheel or a wheel-engaging fixture, and a pivot-selection mechanism operatively disposed between the floating plate and the support structure. The pivot-selection mechanism is selectively configurable among a plurality of working states, each working state defining a respective substantially vertical pivot axis about which the floating plate is permitted to rotate relative to the support structure. Selection of a working state constrains the floating plate against rotation about one or more non-selected axes while permitting pivotal movement about the axis associated with the selected working state. The respective pivot axes may be spaced from one another and positioned to correspond to different wheel locations, vehicle geometries, test configurations, or alignment conditions. In this manner, the effective center of rotation of the wheel mount can be changed without replacing or repositioning the entire assembly, thereby facilitating dynamometer setup, accommodating different test articles, and reducing parasitic forces during testing.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a single-paragraph invention summary for a vehicle test bench wheel support. Explain that the roller is mounted on a horizontally movable floating plate, that the pivot axis can be positioned either before or after the tire contact point relative to the vehicle’s driving direction, and that actuators control rotation in both modes.
counterfactuals.output: A vehicle test bench wheel support includes a roller configured to engage a vehicle tire and mounted on a horizontally movable floating plate that accommodates movement during testing. The support further includes a selectively positionable pivot axis that may be located either before or after the tire contact point relative to the vehicle’s driving direction, thereby enabling distinct operating modes. One or more actuators control rotation of the wheel support in both pivot-axis configurations to provide controlled positioning and simulation of vehicle operating conditions.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a patent abstract for an apparatus that simulates steering behavior on a roller dynamometer by selectively rotating a roller-supporting floating plate about one of two vertical axes situated on opposite longitudinal sides of the wheel contact point.
counterfactuals.output: An apparatus for simulating vehicle steering behavior on a roller dynamometer includes at least one roller configured to support a vehicle wheel and a floating plate supporting the roller. The floating plate is movable relative to a stationary base and selectively rotatable about either of two substantially vertical pivot axes located on opposite longitudinal sides of a wheel contact point on the roller. A pivot-selection mechanism selectively constrains the floating plate at one of the pivot axes, while an actuator rotates the floating plate about the selected axis in response to steering of the wheel or a control signal. Selection between the pivot axes permits the roller assembly to reproduce lateral displacement and yaw behavior associated with different steering directions while maintaining support and rotational operation of the wheel.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
